rationale_detailed.key_strengths: John has substantial professional experience spanning over 14 years, with a solid progression from Technical Support Specialist at Concentrix (2009-2018) to Administrative Assistant at Home Instead Senior Care (2018-2020), then Executive Assistant/Technical Support at The Moving Software (2020-2022), and most recently Client Success Manager at Cre8tive Labs (2022-2024). He demonstrates strong systems thinking with evidence of workflow automation, process improvement, and introducing new software tools to improve efficiency. His technical background provides unique value for troubleshooting and system administration tasks. He shows good ownership by leading team meetings, serving as SME, and managing help desk operations. His stakeholder management skills are evident through vendor coordination, cross-functional collaboration, and client relationship building. He has solid core VA skills including calendar management, email inbox organization, scheduling, and meeting coordination documented in his EA role.
rationale_detailed.key_gaps: Education is from University of Southeastern Philippines (Tier 2, 1 point) with no honors mentioned and a Computer Technology degree which is only moderately relevant to EA work. While he has EA-titled roles, the actual EA experience is limited to approximately 3.5 years (2018-2024), with earlier experience being primarily technical support rather than true executive assistance. Company tier assessment shows mid-level companies - Cre8tive Labs appears to be a small creative agency, The Moving Software is a niche software company, Home Instead is a franchise operation, and Concentrix is the only larger company but in a technical support capacity. No quantified business impact metrics are provided in the resume. Resume design is standard and functional but not visually distinctive. No references provided, no awards or recognition mentioned, no evidence of AI tool usage or professional development activities, and age/life circumstances cannot be determined from the resume.
rationale_detailed.recommendation_reasoning: John scores 52.5/100 which places him in the Tier 2 Viable / Marginal range (50-59). All three thresholds are passed (Experience 10.0, Skills 7.0, Communication 2.0), which normally would suggest PROCEED WITH QUESTIONS. However, the score is on the lower end of this range and the experience, while meeting threshold, is borderline. The EA experience quality is mixed - he has relevant titles but much of his career was technical support rather than strategic executive assistance. The recommendation is PROCEED WITH CAUTION because while he meets all thresholds, the overall profile shows someone transitioning from technical support to EA work rather than a dedicated EA professional with deep strategic experience.
rationale_detailed.interview_focus: 1) Probe depth of EA responsibilities at The Moving Software and Home Instead - what percentage of time was spent on strategic EA work vs technical support tasks? 2) Assess communication quality through interview conversation - written resume is adequate but need to evaluate verbal communication and executive presence. 3) Explore specific examples of business impact and process improvements with quantifiable outcomes. 4) Understand career trajectory motivation - why transition from technical support to EA work? 5) Evaluate judgment and ownership through scenario-based questions about handling competing priorities for executives.
